input.new_string:
## Decisions

- 2026-11-22: Nick: "check why Helen Osman's attestation is showing up twice in the list? She only has one fob." Diagnosis only, no code or data changed. The admin dashboard lists one row per pending `attestation_requests` record (no join fan-out; fob count is irrelevant), and nothing stops a second pending renewal row for the same member and season: `POST /members/[id]/renew` always inserts, the member page Re-send (`attestation-section.tsx` `handleResend`) re-sends by calling Renew again, and the Renew button allows a second click. The member page shows only one pending renewal (`pendings.find`), so the extra row is visible on the dashboard only. Production request log (30 days): three members got two 200 Renew calls 4 to 6 s apart (11, 15, 18 Nov); cron on a 7-day cycle heals a same-day pair to one row at lapse. Not verified: which of Helen's rows exist (logs carry no names, Interceptor extension would not connect, prod DB window not opened from a background job). A scoped fob confirmation alongside a renewal is the other possible cause and renders identically on the dashboard. Proposed, not built: Renew reuses a live pending renewal row (rotate token, re-send) instead of inserting; partial unique index on pending non-scoped (tenant, user, season); completing one row closes siblings; dashboard row labels fob confirmations.

input.command:
git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix(renewals): keep one pending renewal attestation per member and season

Renew inserted a new pending attestation on every call, and the member page
Re-send worked by calling Renew, so a repeated click or a re-send left the
member listed twice on the admin Requests page and holding two live links.
The member page only ever showed one of them.

- Renew re-issues the link on the member's existing pending renewal instead
  of inserting. A repeat inside 60 seconds is treated as a repeated click:
  no second email, no new link, no second audit line. The membership row is
  locked so concurrent calls queue.
- Migration 0022 closes existing duplicates (newest kept, older marked
  expired, per tenant with the tenant context set) and adds a partial unique
  index on pending non-scoped (tenant, user, season).
- Member page Re-send uses resend-attestation on the pending row.
- Renew button reloads the page and shows a notice, so the result of the
  click is visible.
